name: controllerModel
label: Controller model
description: The model representing the controller fields

name: controllerModelPristine
label: Controller model pristine
description: The model representing the controller fields at the last save point

name: isDirty
label: Is dirty
description: True if we have user changes that are unsaved

name: isSaving
label: Is saving
description: True if we are currently saving changes

name: saveCompleted
label: Save completed
description: True if we just finished saving changes

name: snapshotHistory
label: Snapshot history
description: The history of all changes to the controller or it's macroponent for undo/redo

name: invalidFields
label: Invalid fields
description: An array of fields that do not have valid inputs

name: protectionPolicy
label: Protection policy
description: The value of the policy field for the controller macroponent

name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: True if we should be disabled due to cross scope or protection policy
